enhancer.title: Promptly Prompt Enhancer
enhancer.subtitle: Turn raw prompts into clear, structured, high-quality instructions for LLMs.
enhancer.section1Desc: Paste any prompt you currently use with models. The enhancer will keep your intent but improve structure, tone, and clarity.
enhancer.attachHint: Supports images, videos, PDFs, and more
enhancer.section2Desc: This is the improved version. You can copy it directly into your favourite LLM, or keep iterating with Promptly.
enhancer.errorNoPromptToScore: No prompt to score. Enhance first or paste a prompt.
enhancer.errorNoPromptToValidate: No prompt to validate. Enhance first or paste a prompt.
enhancer.statusLlmDisabled: LLM features are disabled. Set OPENAI_API_KEY on the backend to enable prompt rewriting.
enhancer.statusLlmOnline: LLM online. Using model {model} for enhancement.
enhancer.statusLlmUnavailable: Unable to verify LLM status. Enhancement may not work until the backend is reachable.
enhancer.validationNoIssues: No issues found. Prompt looks good.
enhancer.confirmLargeFile: This file is larger than 10MB. It may take longer to process. Continue?
enhancer.logLoaded: Prompt Enhancer loaded. Paste a prompt to get started.

specs.title: Specs Manager
specs.subtitle: Browse, inspect, and compile your Promptly specs into deterministic prompts.
specs.section1Desc: These specs are stored in the backend database. Select one to see details and compile it.
specs.section2Desc: Inspect the raw spec JSON and compile it into prompt blocks for your LLM pipeline.
specs.section3Desc: Paste or type a JSON spec. At minimum, provide a title and a small spec object.
